G: the finite bipartite graph in the theorem
X: the left bipartition class of G
Y: the right bipartition class of G
N(S): the set of vertices of Y adjacent in G to at least one vertex of S
f: the map sending a matched left vertex to its matched right endpoint
n: the cardinality of X, used as the induction parameter
A: a nonempty proper subset of X considered in the induction
G_1: the bipartite subgraph with classes A and N(A) used in Case 1
G_2: the bipartite subgraph with classes X minus A and Y minus N(A) used in Case 1
M_1: a matching in H saturating A
M_2: a matching in K saturating X minus A
G': the subgraph induced after deleting the chosen vertices x and y
M': a matching in G' saturating X minus {x}
N_G(T): the set of vertices in Y adjacent in G to at least one vertex of T
m(x): the vertex of Y matched to x by M
G_A: the subgraph of G induced by A and N(A)
M_A: a matching in G_A saturating A
G_R: the graph obtained from G by deleting A and N(A)
B: a subset of the relevant left bipartition class
M_R: a matching in G_R saturating X_R
X': X minus the singleton containing x
Y': Y minus the singleton containing y
N_G(W): the set of vertices of Y adjacent in G to at least one vertex of W
N: the neighborhood operator: for a subset of a left bipartition class, N returns its adjacent vertices in the right class; subscripts specify the ambient graph
N(U): the set of vertices of Y adjacent to at least one vertex of U, for U contained in X
m: the injective map from X to Y defined by the partners of vertices of X in M
xy: the edge of G joining x to y
H: the subgraph induced by A union N(A)
X_H: the left vertex class X with x deleted
Y_H: the right vertex class Y with y deleted
N_H(T): the neighborhood of T in H
M_H: a matching in H saturating X_H
N_{G_A}(B): the neighborhood of B in G_A
X_R: the left vertex class X with A deleted
Y_R: the right vertex class Y with N(A) deleted
N_{G_R}(C): the neighborhood of C in G_R
K: the subgraph induced by (X minus A) union (Y minus N(A))
x': a second vertex of X used in the injectivity check
